provider_details.provider_name: Sentinel-2 10m Land Cover (Impact Observatory / Esri Living Atlas)
provider_details.satellite_constellation: European Space Agency (ESA) Sentinel-2 (twin optical/multispectral satellites MSI)
provider_details.coverage: Global annual time-series (covering Northeast India, Himalayas, and worldwide)
provider_details.scientific_provenance: Classified directly from Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance imagery using deep learning models trained by Impact Observatory in partnership with Esri and Microsoft. Ground-truthed and benchmarked against global reference data.
provider_details.service_protocol: Esri ImageServer REST identify operation (EPSG:4326 geometry point query)

land_cover_classes.name: Water
land_cover_classes.description: Areas where water was predominantly present throughout the year: rivers, ponds, lakes, reservoirs

land_cover_classes.name: Trees
land_cover_classes.description: Any significant clustering of tall dense vegetation: closed forest, woodland, open tree canopy

land_cover_classes.name: Flooded Vegetation
land_cover_classes.description: Areas of any type of vegetation with obvious intermixing of water: wetlands, swamps, rice paddies

land_cover_classes.name: Crops
land_cover_classes.description: Human-planted/managed cereals, grasses, and crops: agricultural fields

land_cover_classes.name: Built Area
land_cover_classes.description: Human-made structures: buildings, asphalt, paved roads, infrastructure

land_cover_classes.name: Bare Ground
land_cover_classes.description: Areas of bare soil, sand, exposed rocks, quarries, steep barren cliffs, landslide scarps

land_cover_classes.name: Snow/Ice
land_cover_classes.description: Areas of permanent snow, glaciers, and alpine snowfields

land_cover_classes.name: Clouds
land_cover_classes.description: Persistent cloud cover obscuring land surface

land_cover_classes.name: Rangeland
land_cover_classes.description: Open spaces covered by homogenous grasses, shrubs, sparse trees, and alpine meadow

fallback_and_error_behavior.zero_substitution_prohibited: Unavailable, unclassified, or failed provider data is strictly assigned category: 'unknown' and classCode: null. It is NEVER converted to 0 or treated as 'safe' vegetation.
fallback_and_error_behavior.confidence_policy: Strictly null. No arbitrary or fabricated confidence score is generated since the provider identify endpoint returns discrete pixel classes without continuous softmax distributions.
fallback_and_error_behavior.timeout_handling: 5000ms bounded timeout with AbortController/Axios; returns isTimeout: true, available: false, category: 'unknown'.
fallback_and_error_behavior.rate_limit_handling: HTTP 429 detection sets isRateLimited: true, available: false, category: 'unknown', preventing wasted retries.
fallback_and_error_behavior.caching: In-memory LRU-style cache bounded at 1,000 items with 1-hour TTL, keyed on 4-decimal coordinates (~11m spatial resolution).
fallback_and_error_behavior.request_deduplication: In-flight promises for identical rounded coordinates share the active request, preventing duplicate simultaneous network calls.
fallback_and_error_behavior.core_engine_isolation: Satellite land cover failure never impacts or halts the core risk engine, early warning pipeline, or database services.

tests_executed: Sentinel-2 class code to category mappings (Trees -> vegetation, Bare Ground -> bare, Water -> water, Crops -> cropland, Built Area -> built_up, Clouds -> unknown)
ESA WorldCover class code compatibility (Bare -> bare, Grassland -> vegetation)
Unrecognized/empty class code fallback to category: 'unknown' and classCode: null
Coordinate validation (null/missing, NaN/strings, out-of-range latitude, out-of-range longitude, valid extremes)
Successful provider response handling and schema compliance
Provider failure handling (available: false, category: 'unknown', error message preserved)
Timeout handling (isTimeout: true, available: false, category: 'unknown')
HTTP 429 rate limit handling (isRateLimited: true, available: false, category: 'unknown')
Strict safety assertion: missing/failed data is never converted to a safe category or zero
Strict truthfulness assertion: confidence is strictly null
In-memory caching behavior: repeated queries return cached: true without provider invocation; clearCache works as intended
Request deduplication: 3 concurrent requests execute exactly 1 provider call
Controller HTTP 400 rejection for missing query parameters
Controller HTTP 400 rejection for out-of-bounds coordinates
Controller HTTP 200 response with normalized data payload for valid coordinates
Route authentication: GET /api/satellite/land-cover without token returns HTTP 401
Route authentication: GET /api/satellite/land-cover with malformed token returns HTTP 401
limitations: Point queries sample the 10m Sentinel-2 pixel at the exact given coordinate; micro-scale spatial heterogeneity within 10 meters is not resolved.
Identify operations reflect the annual composite classification (2024/2025) rather than daily dynamic changes.
Persistent cloud-covered alpine summits may return class 10 (Clouds), which is handled safely as unknown rather than guessed.
Full multispectral optical bands (B2-B12) and SAR phase coherence are not downloaded locally, preserving lightweight performance.
